strings.zh: 呀~你好！{NEWLINE}哎呀~这真是令人震惊呢！{SCROLL}刚才的精灵是芳缘地区流传的{CLEAR}创世神话里出现的{CLEAR}盖欧卡！！{SCROLL}原来如此~原来如此~{SCROLL}这个埋没之塔是芳缘地方的人们{CLEAR}建造的东西啊。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Well, hello!{NEWLINE}That was something you don’t see{CLEAR}every day!{SCROLL}That Pokémon is Kyogre,{NEWLINE}a legendary Pokémon in the Hoenn myth{CLEAR}about the shaping of that region.{SCROLL}I see...{CLEAR}I see.{SCROLL}The Embedded Tower was built{NEWLINE}by the people from Hoenn.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 如此说来⋯⋯？{SCROLL}连接海洋、陆地、天空的塔⋯⋯{SCROLL}在芳缘神话里出现的精灵并不只有{CLEAR}盖欧卡而已⋯⋯{SCROLL}关于此处还有很多地方不甚明朗,{CLEAR}仍然还留有谜团呢。{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Tower that binds together{NEWLINE}the sea, the land, and the sky...{SCROLL}Kyogre was not the only Pokémon{NEWLINE}described in the Hoenn myth...{SCROLL}This place may still be hiding{NEWLINE}its secrets.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 如果让博学的精灵博士{NEWLINE}看看盖欧卡的话,{CLEAR}或许会得到某些线索？{SCROLL}哎呀哎呀,{NEWLINE}精灵与神话的关系{CLEAR}还真是源远流长呢。{SCROLL}那么,{NEWLINE}下次在哪里再相见吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: The knowledgeable Pokémon Professor{NEWLINE}may be able to tell you more when you{CLEAR}show him Kyogre.{SCROLL}Phew!{SCROLL}There are so many connections between{NEWLINE}Pokémon and myths.{SCROLL}See you around.{SCROLL}
